compiled_state.title: Version-bump KEEP: pinned feature-branch sync before the source-branch bump (resilience SS9.5/SS9.6)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want the ci-pr version bump to stop conflicting on stale-base promotions -- by syncing the feature branch onto current origin/main BEFORE the source-branch bump -- so promotions don't need manual rebase, WITHOUT moving the bump off the reviewed path or weakening provenance.

## SECURITY GUARDRAIL (non-negotiable)
The version SHA MUST keep riding PR1's review-sub-pr (plugin.json allowlisted -> skip-to-success) -> covered per-SHA like any commit. No coverage exemption, no bypass actor. The pre-bump sync rewrites ONLY un-reviewed feature commits that PR1 then reviews fresh -- it MUST NEVER force-push a branch already under in-flight review (that would re-credit a review onto a rewritten SHA).

## Done Definition
- DD1 (Pinned pre-bump feature-sync): retain ADR-0016's source-branch bump. Inside _phase_staged_intermediate (merge-to-main-pr.sh), BEFORE _phase_source_branch_version_bump, sync the feature branch onto origin/main using the SAME origin/main SHA that _create_staged_ref captured (PIN it -- a re-fetched origin/main reopens the conflict via TOCTOU). This makes the PR1 version line single-sided -> clean merge. Reuse _fetch_and_rebase_branch's abort-restore pattern; capture a pre-image patch BEFORE the rebase (always:patch-before-destructive); build it as a first-class phase with its own _state_mark_complete key.
- DD2 (Resume + abort semantics): idempotent on --resume -- SKIP the sync when the feature is already pushed / PR1 already exists (never force-push under in-flight review). On a CODE conflict during the sync: abort cleanly (git rebase --abort + restore HEAD), surface DIRTY/CONFLICT_DATA + the pre-image patch, route to INDETERMINATE/escalate -- never leave a half-rebased branch or a duplicate staged-* ref (the ~:2896 dedup guard was built for crash-recovery, NOT deliberate mid-phase abort -- test this path).
- DD3 (Scope boundary): do NOT generalize _try_reset_stale_version_bump (it resets LOCAL main -- different ref/safety property). Confirm direct mode needs no change (its _phase_sync already merges origin/main before the bump -> single-sided) -> expect ci-pr-only; do not add a redundant/regressive rebase to direct mode. Leave marketplace.json UNTOUCHED (its version/ref pin the stable channel by design; tag-release.sh owns it) + add a guard test asserting bump-version.sh never writes marketplace.json.
- DD4 (S5 coordination): this story REMOVES S5's (0cd7) version-file COVERAGE exemption -- under KEEP the bump is covered via PR1, so only the ticket-store exemption remains. Coordinate so 0cd7's exemption helper drops the version arm (plugin.json stays in the review-gate ALLOWLIST so review-sub-pr skips it).

## HONEST cost (state plainly -- plan SS9.6)
KEEP trades a rare, often auto-absorbable version-line conflict for an EARLIER, occasionally-harder full-branch-rebase conflict: a genuine code conflict now blocks at the bump phase (pre-PR1) instead of at PR-merge. Net positive (the stale-base version conflict was the recurring one; code conflicts surface at merge regardless) but NOT unconditional friction reduction -- it relocates and slightly broadens the conflict surface.

## Live verification
- Stale-base: branch off a stale main, let main advance V0->V1, run a real promotion -> the pinned feature-sync makes the PR1 version line single-sided -> clean merge, no manual rebase.
- Code-conflict: inject a code conflict during the sync -> clean abort + pre-image patch + INDETERMINATE/escalate, NOT a half-rebased branch or duplicate staged-* ref.
- Resume: run --resume after PR1 already exists -> the sync is SKIPPED (no force-push onto the reviewed branch).
- Security: attempt to launder an un-reviewed code change through the version-sync path -> still BLOCKS (the bump rides PR1; provenance intact).

## Dependencies
- relates_to: the resilience-hardening story (shares the security-guardrail framing; disjoint code).
- blocks: 0cd7 (S5 -- the version-file exemption removal, DD4).
- ADR-0016 STANDS (no supersession -- KEEP IS ADR-0016). Source: docs/handoff/resilience-hardening-plan.md SS9.5/SS9.6.

comments.body: LIVE REPRO (2026-06-04): this session hit the exact stale-base version conflict 0f17 fixes while driving 29e7 to main — staged cut from main@v1.17.123, main advanced to v124, branch bumped to v125 -> 3-way plugin.json conflict at PR2 #632; required a manual merge-of-main-into-staged + resolve-to-125. Confirms 0f17's value and that it must land before the enforce-flip (3ee4 / P10). Scope note: 0f17 prevents the conflict ARISING (pinned pre-bump feature-sync); the residual merge-commit-resolution case (if a conflict still reaches the flow) is owned by 4ba5 + cca8, NOT 0f17.

comments.body: IMPLEMENTED + committed 2a5f174f9b on story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/0f17-prebump-sync off main. DD1: _phase_prebump_feature_sync(pinned_sha) wired into _phase_staged_intermediate before the bump; pin = staged ref's tip (TOCTOU-free). DD2: idempotent skip when origin/<branch> exists (never force-push under in-flight review) + abort/hard-restore HEAD on code conflict + pre-image patch + PREBUMP_SYNC_CONFLICT marker + fail-closed on empty/unfetchable pin. DD3: ci-pr-only (direct mode _phase_sync already merges origin/main pre-bump, untouched) + marketplace guard test (bump-version.sh never writes marketplace.json). DD4: no-op (0cd7 KEEP already ticket-store-only). Tests: test-merge-to-main-prebump-sync.sh 5/5 (clean-rebase/idempotent-skip/already-based/conflict-abort-restore/empty-pin) + test-bump-version-marketplace-guard.sh 1/1; existing merge-to-main fn tests green; shellcheck clean. NOTE the merge self-exercises the new code (branch is current -> already-based no-op path).
